title: Uber carried 63% of trips to and from JFK and LaGuardia and to Newark in Aug 2026

subtitles.split: In Aug 2026, Uber led pickups at JFK (53%) and LaGuardia (59%)
subtitles.share_trend: Yellow cabs' share of airport trips fell 1.7 pts between Aug 2025 and Aug 2026
subtitles.by_hour: Airport trips peaked at 2 pm, with 4,380 trips in that hour on an average day over the 3 months to Aug 2026
subtitles.fares: A trip from LaGuardia to Manhattan cost a mean $75.52 before tip in Aug 2026, from $61.94 by yellow cabs to $82.20 by Uber
